reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it carries me through a night shift. Paying 55 for a smaller can of something I don't know, that I'd have to order online, isn't worth swapping out what works.
objection: 80 mg from yerba mate might not hit the way I need at 3 a.m., and it costs more than my Red Bull for less certainty.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a can for free or cheap at a café and finding it actually keeps me sharp through a shift without the crash.
